episodes.title: The Offer
episodes.summary: Struggling and desperate, Dodge accepts an offer to get back on his feet financially. But it comes with a price.

episodes.title: The Motivation
episodes.summary: Debt and a baby on the way make for desperate times. Dodge grows increasingly concerned about the future of his family.

episodes.title: The Rules
episodes.summary: A trip to the hospital reveals a life-changing diagnosis. With nowhere to turn, Dodge is tempted to make a deadly decision.

episodes.title: The Acceptance
episodes.summary: The rules are set. The prize is tempting. And the situation is dire. All Dodge has to do is accept...and the game begins.

episodes.title: The Start
episodes.summary: The game is on. Paranoia, panic and fear settle in for Dodge as the hunters could be anywhere. Or anyone.

episodes.title: Wash Hands After Using
episodes.summary: Crowds are your friend. Dodge ducks into a bustling business center to stay in public-sight and out of danger.

episodes.title: No Running on the Platform
episodes.summary: Dodge's location is revealed to the hunters. Can he escape before it's too late?

episodes.title: Please Whisper in Church
episodes.summary: Dodge tries to find sanctuary in a new location. Meanwhile Valerie questions the source of newfound money in her bank account.

episodes.title: Return Tools to Their Place
episodes.summary: Not all games are fair. Dodge learns a painful lesson when it's revealed that the hunters have a secret advantage.

episodes.title: Five for Fighting
episodes.summary: The stakes get higher the longer Dodge survives. He tries to blend in at a hockey game while Valerie digs deeper into the bank deposits.

episodes.title: You Always Remember Your First
episodes.summary: A bad move brings Dodge to the brink of the Detroit boundary. He's determined to bring the fight back to the city, but the hunters are right on his heels.

episodes.title: A Ship Is Safe Only in Port
episodes.summary: Hard times can bring out the worst in us all. Dodge continues to fight for his life in the face of what he's become. But how long can he keep it up?

episodes.title: Always Get a Second Opinion
episodes.summary: The game gets complicated when Dodge encounters a gang in the projects. And if they don't believe his story, there may be even more bloodshed.

episodes.title: What's Old Is New Again
episodes.summary: Dodge uncovers a truth that reveals the game isn't what it seems. And nobody is to be trusted. Not even those closest to him.

episodes.title: Game Over
episodes.summary: It's the final showdown. With the game spiraling out of control, Dodge gives everything he has to bring it all to an end.

episodes.title: Auction
episodes.summary: Miles searches for the perfect prey to whet the appetites of clients.

episodes.title: Play Ball
episodes.summary: To protect his sister, Victor has no choice but to accept Miles' offer to join the game.

episodes.title: Devil in the Outfield
episodes.summary: The game is on; Victor suspects all New Yorkers of being hunters; he gets a one-minute head start.

episodes.title: On the Wrong Track
episodes.summary: Victor's actions come back to haunt him, and now he must avoid the NYPD along with the hunters.

episodes.title: En Fuego
episodes.summary: Miles is in the hot seat when the Tiro Fund Board gets word of Victor's impending arrest.

episodes.title: Katie Girl
episodes.summary: Cornered and desperate, Victor is forced to relive his childhood trauma.

episodes.title: Busted
episodes.summary: Victor ditches the protection of crowds for isolation at the city's fringes.

episodes.title: A Good Lawyer's Hard to Find
episodes.summary: Following Victor's arrest, he and Miles are on the razor's edge; the hunt spirals out of control.

episodes.title: Company at the Water Company
episodes.summary: Victor is in a fight for his life; the surprises keep on coming as the hunt takes a shocking turn.

episodes.title: One Way Ticket
episodes.summary: Victor's hometown knowledge becomes his best defense, and his only chance for survival.

episodes.title: Lighthouse
episodes.summary: As the hunt careens to a close, Victor just might win the game but lose everything he loves.

episodes.title: Blood Work
episodes.summary: As the hunters close in on Victor and Josie, their chances of surviving dwindle with each moment.
